title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of trastuzumab deruxtecan in patients with HER2-low advanced breast cancer based on DESTINY-Breast04
notes: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is not a cost-effective treatment option for HER2-low metastatic breast cancer from the perspective of the Chinese healthcare system.
